subject: Request: SLO remedy & credit cap for HorizonAI Q4 renewal
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@horizonai.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@horizonai.com
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SLO concession request ahead of renewal

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the renewal chat last week. As we finalize numbers for Q4, our engineering team surfaced continued latency spikes during long-tail inference runs. Because HorizonAI is planning a major model rollout in November, we need a modest SLO concession for the first 90 days post-rollout to avoid penalty outs while we stabilize traffic patterns.

Specifically, we are asking that Redwood:
- Temporarily lower the 99.9% latency target for the "inference.high-priority" route from 200ms to 350ms for a 90-day window starting Nov 1.
- Cap monthly service credits for any sustained availability/latency failure at 5% of monthly invoice (current contract uses a tiered uncapped formula).

We are prepared to commit to a 12-month capacity reservation (Dedicated pool) and increase spend by ~18% if we can get the temporary SLO adjustment and the credit cap in writing. I attached an updated SOW and a short support history export for Q3.

Can you advise next steps and if this needs exec sign-off? We are on a tight procurement cadence and hope to close by Oct 25.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Head of Infrastructure
HorizonAI
[Attachment: HorizonAI_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: support_history_Q3.csv (csv)]
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@horizonai.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SLO concession request ahead of renewal

Elena — thanks for the context and attachments, this is helpful.

Short answer: this request is outside standard SLAs, so we will need authorization from Deal Desk and an exec-level approval for the non-standard credit cap.

I’ve looped in Aditya (deal desk) and Lauren (legal) to evaluate pricing / contract language. Quick clarifying Qs for your procurement team:
- Does the 12-month reservation start Nov 1?
- Is the ~18% incremental spend guaranteed or an estimate contingent on usage?
- Are you looking for the adjusted latency target only on the "inference.high-priority" route or across additional routes?

I’ll coordinate internally and follow up today with a proposed remedy model. If we can agree commercial terms, I can escalate to Sean for exec sign-off.

—Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T13:32:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SLO concession request ahead of renewal — internal assessment

Team — reviewed HorizonAI materials. Summary and proposal:

Background: HorizonAI has a history of bursty long-tail workloads (see support_history_Q3). Their ask is a temporary latency relaxation + a cap on credits. They offer a 12-month Reserved Commitment and ~18% incremental spend if we accept terms.

Commercial risk: uncapped service credits per current SLA can cause outsized credits on high-volume outages; capping reduces financial exposure but is nonstandard.

Proposed remedy (to present to customer):
- Approve temporary 90-day latency target of 350ms for inference.high-priority starting Nov 1.
- Approve a hard cap on monthly service credits of 5% of invoice for the same 90-day window.
- Condition: Customer executes a 12-month Dedicated reservation with commit invoice schedule and a termination notice clause (60 days).
- Additional: Redwood to provide a stabilization plan (engineering runbook + weekly checkpoints) and waived remediation fees for the 90 days.

Impact to Redwood: approx. 0.9% incremental expected revenue loss under mid-range failure assumptions versus unlimited credit exposure; mitigated by committed 12-month uplift.

As this is a non-standard SLA concession, I recommend Sean sign-off with Legal/Finance countersignature. If Sean approves, Kim to deliver updated contract language and DocuSign link to customer.

-Aditi (Aditya Rao)
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SLO concession request ahead of renewal — exec clearance

Approved in principle. Conditions:
1) Cap at 5% monthly credit for the 90-day stabilization window only.
2) Customer must sign the 12-month Dedicated reservation with the commit schedule before Nov 1.
3) Legal to insert explicit remediation runbook and weekly checkpoint cadence into the Master Services Schedule.
4) Finance to pre-approve the reduced exposure model; if Finance flags material risk, this approval is revoked.

Lauren — please prepare the amendment language and route to Finance. Kim — once DocuSign is ready, send to Elena with a clear timeline to close by Oct 25.

-Sean Gallagher
VP, Commercial Operations
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@horizonai.com>
Cc: procurement@horizonai.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-19T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: 90-day SLO stabilization window & 5% credit cap — next steps

Elena — good news: we have provisional executive sign-off on your request with the conditions below. Please see the summary and action items.

What Redwood is approving:
- A 90-day temporary latency SLO adjustment for the "inference.high-priority" route: 99.9% target relaxed to 350ms, effective Nov 1 — Jan 29.
- A hard cap on monthly service credits at 5% of the monthly invoice for the same 90-day stabilization window.
- Redwood will provide a stabilization runbook and weekly checkpoint calls (first checkpoint scheduled Nov 3).
- Waived remediation fees tied to stabilization tasks for the 90 days.

Conditions (must be completed before Nov 1):
1) Customer executes 12-month Dedicated reservation and commit schedule (DocuSign link below).
2) Legal (Lauren) finalizes amendment language; Finance to confirm the mitigated exposure model.
3) Procurement to confirm acceptance of the amended SOW and CLINs.

Next steps for HorizonAI:
- Review and sign: https://docusign.net/Redwood/HZ-Renewal-Offer (expires Oct 25).
- Confirm reservation start date and commit invoices to kimberly_park@redwood.com.

I’ve attached the draft amendment and the SOW you sent earlier for convenience. If we get the signed DocuSign and reservation details this week, we’ll have legal countersigned and engineering runbook scheduled by Oct 27.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
